headline: FDC receives tax refund of Rs 37.22 crore
hook: Cash inflow from past assessment years
summary: FDC has been awarded an aggregate tax refund of Rs 37.22 crore for the assessment years 2012-13 and 2014-15. The refund order was issued to the pharmaceutical company following tax assessments. This recovery adds directly to the company's non-operating cash flows. Indian retail investors of FDC should note the positive impact on the company's short-term liquidity.
why_it_matters: Tax refund boosts short-term cash flow for FDC

headline: FDC announces buyback record date, price, and ratio details
hook: Record date and ratio details announced
summary: FDC has released the record date, price, and ratio details for its upcoming share buyback. Retail investors holding shares as of the record date are eligible to participate in the buyback offer. The corporate action provides an alternative route for shareholder wealth distribution. Shareholders should review the specific ratio and pricing details before the record date.
why_it_matters: Eligible shareholders can tender shares for potential short-term gains.

headline: FDC board approves share buyback proposal
summary: FDC Limited has announced that its board of directors has passed a resolution for the buyback of fully paid-up equity shares. A share buyback typically reduces the total number of shares in the market, potentially boosting earnings per share and returning surplus cash to shareholders. Retail investors holding FDC shares can evaluate the proposed buyback price once details on the size and mechanism are released by the company. Further specifics regarding the record date and quantum are awaited.
whats_next: Announcement of buyback size, price, and record date
why_it_matters: Potential cash payout and EPS boost for existing shareholders

headline: FDC fixes November 13 as record date for buyback
hook: Buyback record date set for November
summary: FDC Limited has announced that November 13, 2026, will serve as the record date for its upcoming share buyback. Eligible shareholders holding shares as of this date will participate in the process. The announcement determines shareholder eligibility for the corporate action. Retail investors holding FDC shares can use this date to qualify for the buyback.
why_it_matters: Hold shares by record date to be eligible for buyback.

headline: FDC Limited announces outcome of board meeting
hook: Routine board proceedings at FDC Limited
summary: FDC Limited has formally communicated the outcome of its board meeting held on October 27, 2026, to the stock exchanges. Such regulatory filings are part of routine corporate compliance for listed entities. Indian retail investors tracking the company need to review the specific exchange filings for any material corporate actions. This disclosure ensures transparency regarding internal board decisions.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no immediate price-moving trigger.
